    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section states that the Rebbe Rayatz announced the writing of this Torah scroll during the farbrengen of Simchat Torah night 1942.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">Regarding the writing of this Torah scroll, it was made known by the Rebbe, our master, Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak, of blessed memory, during the farbrengen on the night of Simchat Torah</t>
    <t s="1">(before the hakafot)</t>
    <t s="2">of the year 5702 (1942).</t>
    <t s="3">And this is his holy language:</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section contains the Rebbe Rayatz's statement that with G-d's help and in the merit of his holy forefathers, he merited the idea of becoming an emissary to write a special Torah scroll for receiving Moshiach.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"With the help of the Blessed One, and in the merit of my holy fathers, of blessed and saintly memory,</t>
    <t s="1">I have merited the idea of becoming,</t>
    <t s="2">with G-d's help,</t>
    <t s="3">an emissary for the benefit and merit of all of Israel, and to write a special Torah scroll – 'The Torah Scroll for Receiving the Face of Moshiach' – for receiving our righteous Moshiach, speedily in our days,</t>
    <t s="4">with you."</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
